patch_info.description: Hardens K.7 rendering with explicit bullet formatting specification, validation gate for highlight rendering, and truncation prevention. Fixes Gemini rendering issue where highlights were output as plain prose without bullet markers.
patch_info.changes_summary: Added VG_K7_HIGHLIGHT_FORMATTING gate, updated K.7 node with rendering_specification, added highlight count validation, added bullet prefix validation
patch_info.breaking_changes: None - v1.8.2 maintains full backward compatibility with v1.8.1

updated_metadata.description: v1.8.2 PATCH RELEASE: Hardens K.7 output with explicit bullet formatting specification and validation gate to prevent Gemini rendering issues where highlights were output as plain prose without bullet markers. Maintains all v1.8.1 capabilities.

patch_history_entry.changes: K.7 rendering specification with explicit bullet formatting (•), highlight count validation, truncation prevention, VG_K7_HIGHLIGHT_FORMATTING gate, temperature reduced to 0.2 for consistent output

rendering_specification.full_section_example:
Ernst & Young | New York, NY
Principal (October 2009 – March 2014)
Managed an 18-person enterprise risk team that provided strategic guidance to financial institutions on capital adequacy and regulatory modeling.
• Directed $16M stress testing transformation for Tier 1 banks, advising CROs on CCAR methodology and automated reporting that reduced Federal Reserve examination findings by 38%.
• Advised insurance boards and audit committees on Solvency II implementation, designing economic capital models and loss reserving methodologies that reduced statutory provisions by 19%.
rendering_specification.generation_instruction: Render all extracted K.7 sections (3-5) to bulleted prose format. DO NOT summarize, truncate, or drop any highlights. Each highlight MUST appear on its own line with • prefix. Verify highlight counts before outputting: TraderSense=2, EY=2, Early Career=1.

VG_K7_HIGHLIGHT_FORMATTING.description: Validates K.7 highlights are formatted with bullet markers (•), all highlights render without truncation, and exact highlight counts match expectations (v1.8.2)

validation_checks.description: Verify each highlight line starts with • prefix

on_fail.message: K.7 highlights missing bullet (•) prefix. Section: {section}, Line: {line_text}

validation_checks.method: count bullet lines in TraderSense section

on_mismatch.message: TraderSense section has {actual_count} highlights (expected 2). Highlights may have been truncated or duplicated.

validation_checks.method: count bullet lines in EY section

on_mismatch.message: Ernst & Young section has {actual_count} highlights (expected 2). Highlights may have been truncated or duplicated.

validation_checks.description: Verify exactly 1 highlight for Early Career
validation_checks.method: count bullet lines in Early Career section

on_mismatch.message: Early Career section has {actual_count} highlights (expected 1). Highlight may have been truncated or duplicated.

validation_checks.description: Verify no highlights are formatted as plain text without bullet prefix
validation_checks.method: detect_pattern: highlight text not preceded by •

on_detected.message: K.7 contains plain prose highlights (no bullet prefix). Text: {detected_text}

validation_checks.method: regex_match: r'^[A-Z].+\s\|\s[A-Z].+$' for each section header

on_fail.message: Section header {section_header} does not match expected format: [Company] | [Location]
